text:
arun: FYI rolled NCCL 2.13.0-rc1 to ap-south-1 canary yesterday night, seeing intermittent hangs on multi-GPU inference (all-reduce stalls). jobs queueing up.
maria: ugh, saw a few alerts around 03:40 UTC. which SKU/instance type? any pattern?
arun: mostly p4d-like nodes (8x A100), but also a couple on mixed nvlink configs. failure mode is the process stops producing tokens — kernel still alive, GPU utilization drops to ~0 and NCCL logs show timeouts.
jeff: can you paste the relevant logs? maybe a handshake/peer discovery issue.
arun: snippet from pod logs:
```
NCCL INFO NCCL 2.13.0rc1
NCCL WARN Timeout at 120000 ms (ring allreduce)
NCCL INFO Abort
```
avalid: deploy-bot: rolled nccl=2.13.0rc1 to ring=ap-south-1/canary @1876543000
lia: also seeing netlink churn on those instances in dmesg, something like "nv_peer_memory: peer alloc failed" in a few hosts.
infra-sre: digging into host-level: no driver change (cuda 12.1 unchanged), but kernel modules reloaded when canary was applied. I see occasional PCIe p2p errors during handshake.
maria: did we change any MTU/eni settings in ap-south? small MTU mismatches can blow up collective joins.
infra-sre: networking config hasn't changed. However, PEER_NODE_LIST for NCCL fallback was expanded in the canary config (to allow p2p across subnets) — maybe a regression in handshake logic.
jeff: can someone run this quick repro on a canary node? steps:
1) launch a 4-GPU job pinned to one host
2) run our allreduce test (small tensors, many iterations)
3) capture NCCL_DEBUG=INFO logs
```
mpirun -np 4 python3 tests/allreduce_perf.py --iters 10000
export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
```
lia: kicked off a job on ap-south-canary-3, attaching logs to the thread in a sec.
arun: short-term mitigation: rolling back NCCL to 2.12.10 on the canary pool? we should avoid global rollback until root cause.
infra-sre: agreed. I'll patch the canary pool with 2.12.10 and leave 2.13 on a tiny experiment subset.
maria: what's the perf delta we saw with 2.13? any improvements worth the risk?
arun: microbenchmarks showed ~3% better reduce latency in big tensors, but small-tensor latency regressed in some NVLink topologies. So tradeoff is real.
jeff: output from one failing run (from lia's attached pod):
```
[0] NCCL WARN Call: connect timeout, failed to handshake with rank 2 after 5 retries
[0] NCCL INFO NET/Connection closed
```
lia: additionally, kube-proxy logs had a transient conntrack drop around the same time on the host.
infra-sre: interesting — conntrack + p2p handshake failure could explain intermittent hangs. NCCL 2.13 changed retry/backoff for TCP handshake.
maria: propose: 1) roll back canary to 2.12, 2) add per-node conntrack counters to our node-exporter dashboards, 3) open vendor ticket with NCCL team with logs + dmesg + topo outputs.
arun: +1. also suggest enabling NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 on canary otherwise processes hang hard.
jeff: also file a test matrix: (nvlink topologies) x (cuda 12.1 driver minor builds) x (nccl 2.12 vs 2.13) x (mtu settings). We need deterministic repro.
infra-sre: rolling back canary now. will update when patch finished.
deploy-bot: action: rollout started -> ap-south-1/canary -> nccl=2.12.10 @1876543500
lia: after rollback, started a stress job on the same host — so far 30 mins stable, no timeouts.
maria: thanks team. infra, can you keep a small 2.13 slice up with tcp+detailed logs so we can hand off to vendor? we want to avoid losing the data to reproduce.
infra-sre: leaving 2 hosts with 2.13 and tightened logging (NCCL_DEBUG=TRACE, strace on worker attach). I'll gather all artifacts and escalate.
arun: opening a formal incident ticket and tagging NCCL vendor. adding repro logs and perf diffs.
jeff: note for postmortem: cost impact because retries increased tail latency — estimated extra GPU-hours ~120 last night in ap-south canary.
maria: ok. keep thread updated, and add any firmware/BIOS differences if found. :heart:
